decisions.decision: Final target hold: Experiment2 background cued recall identified but unconditioned main effect/interaction, conditionalized main effect and separate emotional-valence contrasts not uniquely selected by nonnumeric metadata. Requested partial eta does not identify a specific test; generic replication narrative not transferred. No further probe.

Published Stage2 report explicitly links same named2022 OSF project. Original-method dichotomized numeracy is named in coding-context author quote and source Replication:Dichotomized heading; continuous-numeracy analysis is explicitly an extension. Source Results explicitly focuses full860 sample without post-screening exclusions, distinct supplementary exclusion branch; no N fromdf or multiplied four tasks. Copy printed partial eta.01 and same-Study1 authors support/weaker-effect verdict; success records author hypothesis support, not equivalence to original magnitude. Main-report F5.02 versus SupplementS18 F4.42 discrepancy retained as source inconsistency, no F/p alteration (those fields unassigned).

Held pending final focused review: worker leaves full-sample one-factor versus gender-adjusted/restricted two-factor analysis unresolved while first review asserts uniqueness via shared effect and numeric F examples. Need nonnumeric exact-model correspondence before effect-specific verdict; no default main-effect model.
